claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician Fourth Grade Arthur P. McGowan has a high-confidence match to an official Army entry that renders the surname as McGown.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The uncommon full name and a nonshared protected identifier agree apart from one missing letter in the fixed-width Army surname.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the nonshared protected-identifier match and close uncommon-name agreement; the spelling difference remains explicit.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes wartime identity context but not an immediate pre-OSS assignment or civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The indexed spelling remains unchanged. Arthur P. McGown is retained as a sourced variant. Differing grade snapshots and Army codes are not employer evidence.
